```{r}
# Development-only fixture, not a scientific report or a public helper API.
pkgload::load_all('../../../fluvgeo',quiet=TRUE)
table_env <- fluvgeo:::.fg_report_environment()
```

```{r, results='asis'}
cat('<style>',table_env$report_table_css,'</style>',sep='\n')
```

## What is known

Synthetic tables exercise the same shared helper in Quarto HTML. They do not
represent project evidence. On narrow screens, wide tables scroll within the page.

```{r, results='asis'}
table_env$report_table(data.frame(Item=c('Study scope','Long identifier'),
  Description=c('A clear description wraps without touching the adjacent cell.',
    paste(rep('0123456789abcdef',16),collapse=''))))
table_env$report_table(data.frame(Artifact=c('2006 DEM','2010 DEM'),
  Reference='Not exposed by this inspection',
  Evidence='A long explanation remains legible without hiding or abbreviating the scientific qualification.',
  Analyst='Supplied record',Status='Review required',
  Next='Recover preparation evidence; do not infer a source-to-derivative relationship.'))
```
